items.statement: The submitted work preserves the public Pd2Cl6 system and validates the spectrum geometry.
items.expected: Charge 0, multiplicity 1, formula Pd2Cl6, and Pd-Pd plus six nearest Pd-Cl distances are reported with a validation method.

items.statement: The spectrum is reproducible from transition-level data.
items.expected: Raw/aligned transition energies, intensities, orbital character, and broadening/regeneration information are supplied.

items.statement: The calculated Pd2Cl6 spectrum contains a broad intense lower-energy shoulder near 3170 eV.
items.expected: A distinct broad shoulder is identified near 3170 eV and separated from the principal feature.

items.statement: The shoulder assignment is supported by several Pd d/Cl-valence transitions and not a single isolated line.
items.expected: The agent compares candidate explanations and selects a multiple-transition Pd-Cl interaction explanation only when transition/orbital evidence supports it.
